# Grammarly

> Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that provides real-time feedback, tone detection, and generative AI features across desktop, mobile, browser, and document editing platforms.

Grammarly offers comprehensive writing assistance solutions for individuals, professionals, students, and enterprises, with support for multiple languages and specialized tools for different teams and use cases. The platform integrates across Gmail, Microsoft Word, browsers, and mobile devices while maintaining enterprise-grade security and compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- AI Writing Assistant
- Generative AI
- Tone Detection
- Proofreading
- Paraphrasing
- Brand Voice
- Team Collaboration
- Enterprise Solution
- Multilingual Support
- Browser Extension
- AI Agents
- Security & Compliance
- Real-time Feedback
- Writing Tools

## Core Products & Features

- [Grammarly: Free AI Writing Assistance](https://www.grammarly.com): Grammarly homepage showcasing AI writing assistance across apps
- [Product Features | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/features): Core product features including rewrites, tone, and style guides
- [Artificial Intelligence (AI) at Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/ai): Grammarly AI capabilities for business communication and collaboration
- [Go | Your New Personal AI Assistant](https://www.grammarly.com/go-ai-assistant): Grammarly Go AI assistant product overview and features
- [AI Agents | Grammarly AI Agents Directory](https://www.grammarly.com/ai-agents): AI Agents directory with Grader, Citation Finder, Reader Reactions

## Platform & Integration

- [Grammarly Docs | All-in-one AI Document Editor](https://www.grammarly.com/docs): Grammarly Docs AI document editor with real-time feedback
- [Grammarly for Your Desktop | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/desktop): Desktop app for Word, Pages, Gmail, and browser integration
- [Grammarly for your browser | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/browser): Browser extension for Gmail, YouTube, Instagram writing assistance
- [Grammarly for Mobile | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/mobile): Mobile app for iOS/Android with keyboard and messaging integration
- [Transform your writing in languages spanning Spanish to Italian](https://www.grammarly.com/languages): Multilingual support for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian

## Enterprise & Business Solutions

- [Grammarly for Enterprise](https://www.grammarly.com/business/enterprise): Enterprise solution with SAML SSO, compliance, team collaboration
- [Grammarly for Business | AI Writing Assistance for Teams of all Sizes](https://www.grammarly.com/business): Business solution for teams with style guides and brand voice
- [Grammarly Business for Marketing Teams](https://www.grammarly.com/business/marketing): Marketing teams solution for brand voice and campaign messaging
- [Grammarly Business for Sales Teams](https://www.grammarly.com/business/sales): Sales teams solution for client communication and deal closing
- [Grammarly Business for Customer Experience Teams](https://www.grammarly.com/business/customer-support): Customer support teams solution for service quality and compliance
- [Grammarly Business for Human Resources Teams](https://www.grammarly.com/business/hr): HR teams solution for workplace communication and inclusive language
- [Grammarly for IT Teams](https://www.grammarly.com/business/it): IT teams solution with SOC 2 compliance and data security

## User Segments

- [Grammarly for Professionals | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/professionals): Professional writing tools with Docs, proofreading, paraphrasing
- [Free AI Writing Assistance for Students | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/students): Student writing tool with plagiarism detection and citation support
